sections.heading: About Tyca
sections.body: Tyca Strong is a Burlington/Durham, NC-based social video creator who combines production technique with marketing strategy to create content that feels cinematic, clear, and conversion-focused. With academic training in Video Production, Digital Editing, and Marketing, she approaches each project with a full-funnel mindset: hook quickly, tell the story with intention, and end with a strong call to action. Tyca has produced content for campus organizations and emerging brands, leading projects from pre-production planning through final delivery. Her creative style blends energetic pacing, purposeful sound design, and platform-native storytelling so every Reel, TikTok, or Short is built to earn attention and keep it.
